description: Indexes that Lightroom (Cloud) 9.6 drops at every launch and freeze_build.py re-adds. Measured on an 868K-photo library; see cloud/docs/CLOUD-INDEXES.md. Check every index against all of Lightroom's queries on the same table, not only the ones it speeds up.

queries.name: status_volume_distinct
queries.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT prioritizedSyncStatus, volumeGuidUsedByOriginal,
						volumeGuidUsedByProxy, spaceId
					FROM asset_sync_status_ui
					WHERE keepLocallyConfiguration == ?
						AND prioritizedSyncStatus IN ( ?, ?, ?, ?, ? )

queries.name: status_distinct
queries.sql:
SELECT DISTINCT prioritizedSyncStatus
					FROM asset_sync_status_ui
					WHERE keepLocallyConfiguration == ?
						AND prioritizedSyncStatus IN ( ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ? )

queries.name: searchable_limit1
queries.sql:
SELECT prioritizedSyncStatus
					FROM asset_sync_status_ui
					WHERE isSearchable == 1
						AND keepLocallyConfiguration == ?
						AND prioritizedSyncStatus IN ( ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ? )
					LIMIT 1

queries.name: aux_local_sum
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(fileSize) FROM purgeCandidates WHERE binaryType == ? AND hasLocalFile == 1

queries.name: original_volume_sum
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(fileSize) FROM purgeCandidates WHERE binaryType == ? AND hasLocalFile == 1 AND isPurgeable == 1 AND volumeGuidUsedByFile == ?

queries.name: original_local_sum
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(fileSize) FROM purgeCandidates WHERE binaryType == ? AND hasLocalFile == 1

queries.name: proxy_volume_sum
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(fileSize) FROM purgeCandidates WHERE binaryType == ? AND hasLocalFile == 1 AND isPurgeable == 1 AND volumeGuidUsedByFile == ?

queries.name: proxy_local_sum
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(fileSize) FROM purgeCandidates WHERE binaryType == ? AND hasLocalFile == 1

queries.name: xmp_develop_local_sum
queries.sql: SELECT SUM(fileSize) FROM purgeCandidates WHERE binaryType == ? AND hasLocalFile == 1

queries.name: xmp_digest_except
queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT contentIdOrSha256 FROM purgeCandidates WHERE binaryType == 'xmp_develop' AND hasLocalFile == 1 AND isPurgeable == 1 EXCEPT SELECT contentIdOrSha256 FROM purgeCandidates WHERE binaryType == 'xmp_develop' AND (isPurgeable == 0)

optional.name: firstpair_status_ui_keep_prioritized_v1
optional.note: DO NOT USE: Lightroom's photo-list status query (CARRAY docId join + keepLocallyConfiguration + prioritizedSyncStatus IN) picks this index and takes 10.7 s (1.5 s even with ANALYZE) instead of 0.0006 s on asset_sync_status_ui_docId, causing Versions 10-second timeouts when opening photos.

optional.name: firstpair_status_ui_configuration_mask_cover_v1
optional.note: ~10x faster sync-status bitmask album/asset queries (0.35 s -> 0.036 s) but ~6.5 s private / likely 20-30 s live build; not in the default list
